tools.name: kovee_contribution_append
tools.description: Append one immutable Contribution to a branch: present the target branch and expected head digest for the §10.3 compare-and-swap (a stale writer must rebase or fork). Caller-suppliable §10.2 fields only — sequences, author, and content digest are server-derived. Mutation — gated.

branch_id.description: The branch appended to (§10.3 branch key; recorded on the Contribution as origin_branch_id — gap note KG20).

expected_head_digest.description: The §10.3 expected branch head digest for compare-and-swap; a stale writer must rebase or fork (gap note KG20).

body_parts.description: §10.2 body_parts[]; at most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

schema_ref.description: Contribution payload schema (§10.2); server-defaulted when omitted and always present in the result projection (gap note KG21).

subject_refs.description: §10.2 subject_refs[]; every ref points to an object in the same space or an admitted local copy (§10.2). At most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

source_refs.description: §10.2 source_refs[]; provenance refs under the same same-space/admitted-copy rule (§10.2). At most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

classification_ref.description: Optional: defaults from the Space's default classification when omitted (gap note KG21); appending reauthorizes every referenced object and joins its classification (§10.2).

retention_policy_ref.description: Optional: defaults from policy when omitted (gap note KG21).

artifactPart.description: ArtifactPart {artifact_ref, title?} (§10.2); nothing may reference an artifact as available before finalization completes (§10.10).

contributionKind.description: Closed ContributionKind enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed). Only services may append a system_notice (§10.4) — a registry/authorization rule, not schema-expressible.

contributionPart.description: §10.2 ContributionPart union, discriminated structurally by the disjoint closed required member sets of its five arms — no type tag exists in the record model; §14.1's {"type": "text"} literal is SDK sugar (gap note KG21).

value.description: Typed data validated by the schema at schema_ref; any JSON value here (§10.2 DataPart). Unknown extension kinds remain inert data and never create authority (§10.2).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

displayName.description: Display name bounded by the §11.8 cap of 256 Unicode scalar values, length-bounded again at admission.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

inlineText.description: Contribution inline text content, bounded by the §11.8 64 KiB contribution-inline-content cap; maxLength counts Unicode scalar values and the byte cap is re-checked at admission (gap note KG21).

languageTag.description: BCP 47-shaped language tag for TextPart.language (§10.2 names the field with no encoding; recorded extraction bound, gap note KG21).

mediaType.description: RFC 6838 type/subtype token pair (media_type/declared_media_type); parameters are not carried in these fields — recorded extraction bound (gap note KG21/KG29).

mentionPart.description: MentionPart (§10.2); a structured mention resolves an exact visible alias/deployment revision and is inert address data without a direct invocation command or an accepted AttentionContract (§10.4).

referencePart.description: ReferencePart {object_ref, object_revision?, digest?} (§10.2); every ref points to an object in the same space or an admitted local copy (§10.2).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

tools.name: kovee_contribution_show
tools.description: Read one Contribution by id (participant-scoped projection). Read-only — safe to allow.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

tools.name: kovee_contribution_list
tools.description: List Contributions in a Space (optional branch/kind narrowing) under the §11.5 page envelope; filters narrow, never widen, visibility. Read-only — safe to allow.

space_id.description: Exact Space scope (gap note KG9 — scopes never widen visibility).

branch_id.description: Narrowing-only filter to one visible branch (gap note KG9).

contributionKind.description: Closed ContributionKind enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed). Only services may append a system_notice (§10.4) — a registry/authorization rule, not schema-expressible.

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

pageLimit.description: Explicit page read limit; at most 512 (§11.8).

tools.name: kovee_relation_assert
tools.description: Assert one semantic SpaceRelation between exact object revisions on a branch (compare-and-swap append). No relation_class argument exists: an external caller can never request, spoof, or upgrade a structural relation (§10.2). Mutation — gated.

branch_id.description: The branch appended to (§10.3 branch key; recorded as origin_branch_id — gap note KG20).

expected_head_digest.description: The §10.3 expected branch head digest for compare-and-swap (gap note KG20).

schema_ref.description: Relation payload schema (§10.2); server-defaulted when omitted (gap note KG21 pattern).

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

objectRefTriple.description: Exact endpoint pin {object_ref, revision, digest} (§10.2 SpaceRelation from_ref/to_ref; exact object refs always include the applicable revision and canonical digest, §10 preamble).

relationKind.description: Closed RelationKind enum, verbatim §10.2 (§11.8: closed). A relation confers no visibility, admission, truth, trust, acceptance, scheduling, execution, or permission (§10.2).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

tools.name: kovee_space_show
tools.description: Read one Space record by id. Read-only — safe to allow.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

tools.name: kovee_context_assembly_show
tools.description: Read one ContextAssembly (selection evidence: items, omissions, digests) by assembly id. Read-only — safe to allow.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

tools.name: kovee_artifact_upload_begin
tools.description: Begin one artifact upload: declare the raw sha-256, size, and media type (§10.10); limits, expiry, and the staging key are server-derived from realm policy, and the result is the narrow canonical projection — never a credential. First step of the flow the C3a sheet names artifact_upload. Mutation — gated.

classification_ref.description: Optional: defaults from realm policy when omitted (gap note KG29).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

mediaType.description: RFC 6838 type/subtype token pair (media_type/declared_media_type); parameters are not carried in these fields — recorded extraction bound (gap note KG21/KG29).

rawSha256.description: Ordinary raw SHA-256 content checksum (raw_sha256/declared_raw_sha256, §10.10) for integrity and content-addressing; a different field type from the §11.8 typed digests, never interchangeable with them even when the 32-byte values match (§11.8).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

tools.name: kovee_artifact_upload_show
tools.description: Read one ArtifactUpload record (status and declared constraints) by upload id; storage members are durable references, never credentials (§10.10). Read-only — safe to allow.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

tools.name: kovee_artifact_upload_credential
tools.description: Obtain a fresh short-lived storage credential for an open upload (§10.10). Non-mutating, but the result carries a live credential that is never stored in a canonical projection (gap note KG29) — authority-bearing, so it stays gated.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

tools.name: kovee_artifact_upload_finalize
tools.description: Finalize one upload after the bytes are staged: verification pins the declared checksum, and nothing may reference the artifact as available before finalization completes (§10.10). Mutation — gated.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

tools.name: kovee_artifact_upload_abort
tools.description: Abort one open upload (optional bounded reason); staged bytes are discarded. Mutation — gated.

freeText.description: Bounded free text. §11.8 bounds free text again at admission; the 4096-scalar schema ceiling is the recorded extraction bound (ops README gap note KG8).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

tools.name: kovee_artifact_show
tools.description: Read one finalized Artifact record by id; artifact ids are not bearer secrets and every fetch reauthorizes (§10.10). Read-only — safe to allow.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

tools.name: kovee_events_read
tools.description: Read committed events from a source stream after a cursor (§11.4) with optional type-prefix narrowing. The participant-scoped binding pins the project scope, so no project_id argument exists on this tool. Read-only — safe to allow.

source.description: Event source selector (§11.4); opaque — the public cursor encodes source stream, sequence, snapshot epoch, and filter boundary and is never a NATS sequence (§11.3).

type_prefixes.description: §11.4 type_prefixes; at most 256 list items per request (§11.8).

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).

eventTypePrefix.description: Reverse-domain event-type prefix filter (§11.4 type_prefixes); filters narrow, never widen, the authorized delivery set (gap note KG28).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

pageLimit.description: Explicit page read limit; at most 512 (§11.8).

tools.name: kovee_events_wait
tools.description: Long-poll for events after a cursor with a bounded timeout (§11.4); filters narrow, never widen, the authorized set. Read-only — safe to allow.

filters.description: Delivery filters (§11.4 names the member with no grammar); open object that narrows, never widens, the authorized set (gap note KG28).

timeout_ms.description: Long-poll timeout in milliseconds (§11.4); DESIGN.md pins no ceiling (gap note KG28).

cursor.description: Opaque, authenticated cursor or snapshot token (§11.3, §11.5); the 4096-char ceiling is the K0 cursor-cap extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md item 9).

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

excluded_surfaces.assertion: No worker- or operator-surface operation is bound as a tool, ever.
